plan.title: Test ceiling smoke detector
plan.summary: Test ceiling detector with its test button and confirm loud alarm and reset.

steps.title: Locate detector
steps.instruction: Stand under the ceiling smoke detector where you can reach it comfortably standing. You can reach it without a ladder.
stopIf: detector is hanging loose or damaged
ceiling is wet or stained around detector

steps.title: Check power light
steps.instruction: Look at the detector for a small green or red power light. Note if it is on, blinking, or off.

steps.title: Press test button
steps.instruction: Press and hold the center test button with your finger for 3 to 5 seconds until the alarm sounds.

cautions.text: Alarm will be very loud, stand slightly back and warn others nearby.

steps.title: Confirm alarm sounds
steps.instruction: Listen for a loud repeating beep and watch for flashing red light while holding the button.

cautions.text: Alarm will be very loud, do not put ear next to detector.

check.whatDoneLooksLike: Finger on test button with detector sounding

steps.title: Release and reset
steps.instruction: Release the test button. Wait 10 seconds for the alarm to stop and the power light to return to normal.

steps.title: Check result
steps.instruction: Decide result: if it beeped loudly and reset, test passed. If no sound, no light, or it did not reset, replace battery if fitted or replace detector per manual.
